thread.title: Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, SBUX, KHC, COF, EQIX

author: www.4-traders.com
title: Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, SBUX, KHC, COF, EQIX
text:
Apple declared a cash dividend of $0.73 per share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on November 15, 2018 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2018 .
Starbucks declared a cash dividend of $0.36 per share, payable on November 30, 2018 , to shareholders of record as of November 15, 2018 .
The Kraft Heinz Company (KHC) declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.625 per share of common stock payable on Dec. 14, 2018 , to stockholders of record as of Nov. 16, 2018 .
Capital One Financial Corporation (COF) announced a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share payable November 23, 2018 , to stockholders of record as of November 12, 2018 .
Equinix (EQIX) has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $2.28 per share on its common stock. The quarterly common stock dividend will be paid on December 12, 2018 , to shareholders of record on November 14, 2018 .
